title: Mitigation Recommendations
description: Surfaces concrete mitigation actions — fuel treatment, defensible space, structural hardening — drawn from authoritative wildfire protection documents.

title: Wildfire Planning Document Hub
description: Organizes and indexes mitigation guidebooks, prevention templates, and research reports so communities and planners can find what applies to them.

title: Plain-Language Risk Patterns
description: Translates Alberta wildfire statistics — causes, seasonal trends, size distributions — into clear explanations for non-technical audiences.

title: Community Preparedness Education
description: Plain-language content connecting data-driven risk factors (wind, drought, ignition cause) to preparedness actions communities can take before fire season.

title: Region-Specific Insights
description: Breaks down fire history and risk factors by Alberta forest area, so planning reflects local conditions rather than province-wide averages.

title: Mitigation Knowledge Hub
description: A searchable library tying together planning documents, dataset findings, and methodology notes in one place.

title: AI-Assisted Fire Risk Prediction
description: A trained ensemble (Logistic Regression + Random Forest) that estimates large-fire escalation probability from fire and weather conditions — currently in research validation.

title: RAG-Powered Mitigation Assistant
description: A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers mitigation questions by grounding responses in the document library and knowledge graph — in development.

title: Weather & Map Integration
description: Planned integration with live weather feeds and geospatial overlays to connect current conditions to localized risk.
